title: French Almond Crumble
description: A delicious French dessert featuring a crunchy almond crumble topping and a sweet, nutty bottom. Enjoy as a dessert or snack.
instructions: Mix together almonds, nutty, and sugar in a bowl.
Add in crumble and mix until well combined.
Press mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned.
While the base is baking, mix together butter and crumble in another bowl.
Once the base is ready, spread the crumble mixture evenly on top.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool before serving.
